narrativeProgression.description: James English discusses his family background and the sectarian tensions in Northern Ireland.
He describes the murder of his friend James by loyalist paramilitaries and his subsequent decision to join the IRA.
He explains his motivations for joining the IRA, his disillusionment with British rule, and his desire for change.
He recounts his capture by British authorities and the subsequent abuse he endured.
He describes the brutal conditions he faced in prison, the hunger strikes, and his hatred for the prison guards.
He reflects on the impact of these experiences on his father.
